story.title: The crash!
paragraphs_en: One day, A beautiful girl called Elena who had a pet puppy called Tiddles who loved being stroked and loved sausages went to the park as normal, when they heard a... CRASH SOUND! It was so load that people could hear it at the other side of the planet!

A few days later, they were all talking about the crash sound. Then Elena had an idea , "What if the crash sound is the sound is the sound of a planet from far away crumbling down" then her puppy said "Woof Woof!" . Little did they know that what they said was true, planet plumerentie was actually breaking apart!

A few weeks later all scientists were getting all excited because of the new planet that they had just discovered. One scientist called babra discovered that bitts of the planet were heading towards planet earth! Now everyone was panicing about the news and trying to stop our planet from being destroyed. Elena was a very clever girl so she had a few plans up her sleeve to stop this from happening!

"This be the end of the world!" Said everyone. Elena thought "I will never let this happen" ,Elena strongly disagreed. So Elena quickly made a plan and then BOOM! She was ready to save the day ,nobody agreed that Elena could do this because she was only 9. but she just ignored that thought and carried on.

First she got in the rocket on her own and flew up to space and with her extra strong hands she pushed back the planet and saved the day! Then she hopped in her rocket and zoomed back to earth. When she got home they all had a big celebration and where known as the superheroes. Then they lived happily ever after The end.
